3 Bed | 2 Bath | 1,350 sqft | $2,400/month  (rent range $2,400 - $2,550 depending on floor)
Pets: Pets allowed with management approval. Dogs up to 50 lbs. Dogs over 50 lbs may be considered, additional $600 deposit. Pet rent $40/mo.
